_readme: The cards actually pulled on camera. Drives /hall.html, ranked by value.
Filled from the Card Hall of Fame column on the Chase Cards tab of the
spreadsheet, via scripts/import-cards.mjs. Prices are not stored here:
they are looked up from data/psa10.json and public/data/sets.json at build
time, so one price update moves every page that shows that card.
This is the opposite of data/wanted.json. Wanted is what the owner is chasing;
this is what he caught. A card can be in both while he chases a second copy.
art: WHAT THE PICTURE ON THE CARD ACTUALLY SHOWS, one sentence each, keyed
<set-id>-<number>. Every sentence was written by opening that card's own scan
and looking at it. Nothing here is generated, so nothing here may be added
without opening the scan either: an invented sentence is a fabricated claim on
a site whose whole credibility is that its claims are traceable.
A promo has no set id, so it is keyed `mep-` plus its number, the same MEP
Black Star Promos the rip log resolves it against.
`name` sits beside `look` so the key can never quietly move a description onto
a different card. build-hall.mjs checks the name and drops the sentence when it
disagrees, which is the standing pattern here: absent beats wrong.
It says nothing about rarity, print run, odds or value, and it does not repeat
the name, set or number, all of which are printed beside the card already.

chaos-rising-122.name: Mega Greninja ex
chaos-rising-122.look: Gold on gold, one tone of it over another, so the whole figure reads as silhouette and shadow instead of color.

journey-together-162.name: Wailord
journey-together-162.look: Wailord hangs almost still over a reef of pink and orange coral, so big that the little boat on the sunset surface above him looks like a toy.

mep-023.name: Mega Charizard X ex
mep-023.look: Mega Charizard X rears up wrapped in blue flame while the katakana for Inferno X blasts across the top in red, over a comic book burst of pink and green.

journey-together-169.name: Noibat
journey-together-169.look: Noibat perches on a ledge in a glowing crystal cave, holding a piece of pink fruit, with pale blue water running below.

mep-024.name: Oricorio ex
mep-024.look: Oricorio sweeps its red plumage into a ring of fire, with dark tropical flowers and leaves packed in tight behind it.

mega-evolution-146.name: Marshadow
mega-evolution-146.look: Marshadow stands in the forest shade with its eyes lit red, while a Pikachu big enough to fill the bottom of the card sits right in front of it.

journey-together-179.name: Brock's Scouting
journey-together-179.look: Brock plants both hands on his hips and grins with his eyes shut, white fence and green trees behind him under a big blue sky.

mega-evolution-154.name: Stufful
mega-evolution-154.look: Stufful sits in the middle of a living room it has just wrecked, stuffing and toy blocks still hanging in the sunlight.

journey-together-024.name: Blaziken ex
journey-together-024.look: Blaziken lands a strike with a blast going off beside it, rock and fire thrown out across a dusty canyon.

surging-sparks-230.name: Cyrano
surging-sparks-230.look: Cyrano tips the brim of his white fedora and smirks sideways at you, cream suit, red bow tie, green eyes.

surging-sparks-186.name: Scramble Switch
surging-sparks-186.look: No Pokemon at all: just the gadget, a yellow case flipped open with a blue dial and two red arrows chasing each other, floating on hot pink light.

surging-sparks-198.name: Feebas
surging-sparks-198.look: Feebas hangs in green pond water among tall weed stems, lit by whatever daylight makes it down that far.

ascended-heroes-225.name: Scorbunny
ascended-heroes-225.look: Scorbunny throws itself backward into a heap of fall leaves, laughing, with leaves still flying up around it.

chaos-rising-090.name: Ampharos
chaos-rising-090.look: Ampharos stands in a flowering meadow at dusk with its tail bulb lit red and a whole flock grazing in the field behind it.

phantasmal-flames-118.name: Dawn
phantasmal-flames-118.look: Dawn strides forward with her fist up and a grin, yellow bag swinging, pink blossom drifting past on a bright spring day.

chaos-rising-087.name: Chespin
chaos-rising-087.look: Chespin stands on a mossy fallen trunk holding a stick like a sword, sunbeams coming down through the trees behind it.

mega-evolution-159.name: Mega Gardevoir ex
mega-evolution-159.look: Mega Gardevoir lifts one arm as ribbons of magenta and yellow whip around her gown, with a second Gardevoir sketched behind her in pink outline.

perfect-order-106.name: Mega Skarmory ex
perfect-order-106.look: Mega Skarmory spreads gold and blue steel wings over an orange and purple starburst, its own head outlined twice more in the background.

mega-evolution-151.name: Spearow
mega-evolution-151.look: A whole flock of Spearow mills around in the scrub, the nearest ones so close they run right off the edge of the card.

pitch-black-094.name: Toucannon
pitch-black-094.look: Toucannon banks through a bright jungle beak first, wings out, the whole place drawn as flat cutout shapes in pale green and blue.

pitch-black-100.name: Rampardos ex
pitch-black-100.look: Rampardos throws both arms up and grins straight ahead, framed by an orange sunburst that fills the whole card.

destined-rivals-197.name: Rotom
destined-rivals-197.look: Rotom hovers grinning over a workbench buried in gadgets, tools and tangled wire, spoiled for choice.

pitch-black-092.name: Thievul
pitch-black-092.look: Thievul leaps from roof to roof on a teal night with something orange in its mouth and the town's rooftops falling away below.

pitch-black-093.name: Bastiodon
pitch-black-093.look: Bastiodon plants itself face on in a red rock canyon, its shield of a head looking like one more slab of the cliff behind it.

phantasmal-flames-056.name: Mega Gengar ex
phantasmal-flames-056.look: Mega Gengar hangs upside down and grins right at you, one eye yellow and one red, over slashes of green and red.

ascended-heroes-135.name: Mega Scrafty ex
ascended-heroes-135.look: Mega Scrafty fills the whole frame with one furious eye and its white hood thrown back, red slashes cutting across everything.

phantasmal-flames-036.name: Mismagius ex
phantasmal-flames-036.look: Mismagius drifts out of a cloud of pink sparks, its yellow eyes and the red beads at its neck the only solid things in the picture.

pitch-black-065.name: Mega Excadrill ex
pitch-black-065.look: Mega Excadrill grits its teeth mid drill, sparks coming off the steel and broken rock tumbling out of the frame.

pitch-black-045.name: Rampardos ex
pitch-black-045.look: Rampardos leads with its blue dome of a head and the rock gives way, shards flying out past the edges.

perfect-order-021.name: Mega Starmie ex
perfect-order-021.look: Mega Starmie turns its red core to the front with gold arms fanned around it, over splashes of hot pink and lime.

pitch-black-038.name: Mega Chandelure ex
pitch-black-038.look: Mega Chandelure hangs like an actual chandelier, black iron arms curling out from a pale glass orb with blue and pink flame on every one.

chaos-rising-035.name: Mega Floette ex
chaos-rising-035.look: Mega Floette stands calmly off to one side while the enormous dark flower beside it fires a beam of white light off the edge of the card.

destined-rivals-136.name: Marnie's Grimmsnarl ex
destined-rivals-136.look: Grimmsnarl grins and winds up a ball of pink light, with Marnie herself watching from a coin sized portrait in the corner.

chaos-rising-073.name: Cinccino ex
chaos-rising-073.look: Cinccino curls in midair with its white scarf fur spiraling around it and points of light popping off the ends.

chaos-rising-003.name: Beedrill ex
chaos-rising-003.look: Beedrill comes in stinger first with gold light streaking off its wings and grass torn up out of the field below.

phantasmal-flames-084.name: Mega Lopunny ex
phantasmal-flames-084.look: Mega Lopunny snaps out a kick with the rocks still in the air around it and pink and orange streaks cutting across the frame.

mega-evolution-003.name: Mega Venusaur ex
mega-evolution-003.look: Mega Venusaur roars with its jaws wide open, the huge flower on its back leaning forward with it, yellow and blue ribbons flying past.

destined-rivals-065.name: Cetitan ex
destined-rivals-065.look: Cetitan bursts out of a blizzard mouth first, snow spray flying off its white hide in every direction.

journey-together-031.name: Volcanion ex
journey-together-031.look: Volcanion braces as the two vents on its back blow white hot, ringed in loops of fire and orange steam.

ascended-heroes-252.name: Stunfisk ex
ascended-heroes-252.look: Stunfisk lies there flat, face pointed straight at you, on a plain orange sunburst, and that is the whole picture.

phantasmal-flames-029.name: Rotom ex
phantasmal-flames-029.look: Rotom grins out of a burst of blue lightning that spikes off in every direction against a purple starfield.

perfect-order-016.name: Salazzle ex
perfect-order-016.look: Salazzle rears back with pink fire curling off both claws over a cracked orange lava field.

paradox-rift-046.name: Tsareena ex
paradox-rift-046.look: Tsareena swings a leg over in a shower of pink and green crystal, the whole kick cut like glass.

phantasmal-flames-129.name: Dawn
phantasmal-flames-129.look: Dawn walks her red bicycle up a mountain path, grinning under her white beanie, with a lake, a village and green peaks opening out behind her.

perfect-order-108.name: Energy Recycler
perfect-order-108.look: No Pokemon at all: five energy symbols, grass, fire, fighting, water and lightning, glowing like planets on looping white orbits over a green field.

perfect-order-111.name: Lumiose City
perfect-order-111.look: A Bunnelby stands alone on a wide empty boulevard of pale apartment blocks that runs straight down to the tower at the end of it.

perfect-order-115.name: Sacred Ash
perfect-order-115.look: No Pokemon at all: a tan drawstring pouch with green beads on its cords, tipped over and spilling a mound of pale glittering ash.

ascended-heroes-263.name: Team Rocket's Transceiver
ascended-heroes-263.look: No Pokemon at all: a black and blue walkie-talkie with a red R on its face and a stub aerial, lit up over a wall of hot pink circuitry.

journey-together-181.name: Ruffian
journey-together-181.look: A grinning man in a yellow cap and a gold chain holds one hand out open, standing against a rusted corrugated wall with a scrapyard behind him.
